mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS id, base.tenant_id, base.stat_date, base.process_def_key, base.process_def_name, base.total_count, base.completed_count, base.failed_count, COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_event_count, 0) AS timeout_count, COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_event_count, 0) AS timeout_event_count, COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_instance_count, 0) AS timeout_instance_count, COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_event_count, 0) AS anomaly_count, COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_event_count, 0) AS anomaly_event_count, COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_instance_count, 0) AS anomaly_instance_count, base.avg_duration_ms, base.min_duration_ms, base.max_duration_ms, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((base.completed_count * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS success_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((base.failed_count * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS failed_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_instance_count, 0) * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS timeout_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_instance_count, 0) * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS timeout_instance_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_instance_count, 0) * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS anomaly_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_instance_count, 0) * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS anomaly_instance_rate, CASE WHEN base.total_count > 0 THEN ROUND(((base.failed_count + COALESCE(timeout_stats.timeout_instance_count, 0) + COALESCE(anomaly_stats.anomaly_instance_count, 0)) * 100.0 / base.total_count), 2) ELSE 0 END AS risk_score, NOW() AS create_time, NOW() AS update_time FROM ( SELECT pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time) AS stat_date, pm.process_def_key, MAX(pm.process_def_name) AS process_def_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pm.status IN ('FAILED', 'TERMINATED', 'REJECTED', 'INVALIDATED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN AND pm.duration IS NOT NULL THEN pm.duration END)), 0) AS avg_duration_ms, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN AND pm.duration IS NOT NULL THEN pm.duration END), 0) AS min_duration_ms, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN AND pm.duration IS NOT NULL THEN pm.duration END), 0) AS max_duration_ms FROM wf_process_monitor pm WHERE pm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(pm.start_time) = #{statDate} AND pm.process_def_key = #{processDefKey} GROUP BY pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time), pm.process_def_key ) base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.tenant_id, x.stat_date, x.process_def_key, COUNT(*) AS timeout_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT x.instance_id) AS timeout_instance_count FROM ( SELECT pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time) AS stat_date, pm.process_def_key, pm.instance_id, ta.id FROM wf_timeout_alert ta JOIN wf_process_monitor pm ON ta.alert_type = 'PROCESS' AND pm.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND pm.instance_id = ta.target_id UNION ALL SELECT pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time) AS stat_date, pm.process_def_key, pm.instance_id, ta.id FROM wf_timeout_alert ta JOIN wf_task_monitor tm ON ta.alert_type = 'TASK' AND tm.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND tm.task_id = ta.target_id JOIN wf_process_monitor pm ON pm.tenant_id = tm.tenant_id AND pm.instance_id = tm.instance_id ) x WHERE x.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND x.stat_date = #{statDate} AND x.process_def_key = #{processDefKey} GROUP BY x.tenant_id, x.stat_date, x.process_def_key ) timeout_stats ON timeout_stats.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND timeout_stats.stat_date = base.stat_date AND timeout_stats.process_def_key = base.process_def_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time) AS stat_date, pm.process_def_key, COUNT(*) AS anomaly_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.instance_id) AS anomaly_instance_count FROM wf_anomaly_alert aa JOIN wf_process_monitor pm ON pm.tenant_id = aa.tenant_id AND pm.instance_id = aa.instance_id WHERE pm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(pm.start_time) = #{statDate} AND pm.process_def_key = #{processDefKey} GROUP BY pm.tenant_id, DATE(pm.start_time), pm.process_def_key ) anomaly_stats ON anomaly_stats.tenant_id = base.tenant_id AND anomaly_stats.stat_date = base.stat_date AND anomaly_stats.process_def_key = base.process_def_key
